final: WITH grp AS (SELECT q.constructorId AS cid, c.nationality AS nat, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM qualifying q JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = q.constructorId GROUP BY q.constructorId, c.nationality), natTot AS (SELECT nat, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM grp WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY nat), ratios AS (SELECT g.cid, g.nat, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS ratio FROM grp g JOIN natTot t ON t.nat = g.nat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avgRatio FROM ratios WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT r.cid, r.nat, r.cnt, r.ratio, r.ratio / o.avgRatio AS lastRatio FROM ratios r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.avgRatio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (r.ratio / o.avgRatio) IS NULL, r.ratio / o.avgRatio DESC LIMIT 10
